stuff.label: Run stuff rate (no gain or loss)

method.adjusted: weighted ridge: game value = mean + offense + defense + home field; schedule counted once; shrinkage by sample size; FCS games excluded
method.garbage_time: efficiency excludes plays when the margin exceeds 38 (Q2), 28 (Q3) or 22 (Q4)
method.power: games against ACC, Big Ten, Big 12, SEC and Notre Dame (Pac-12 through 2023)
method.trend: last 4 games versus earlier games, opponent-adjusted; labelled only beyond 1.645 standard errors
method.volatility: standard deviation of opponent-adjusted game values (5+ games)

source: CollegeFootballData play-by-play and drives (derived counts); research/v8
